description: Personal health/fitness dashboard. Serverless AWS backend (Python 3.13 Lambdas, DynamoDB, SAM) with scheduled ingest from HealthAutoExport, Withings, Strava, and Hevy.
scope_note: Introduced with the Hevy set-level ingestion work; documents backend/ with emphasis on the ingest -> compute -> lift-learning flow. Extend as other areas are touched.

shared_modules.responsibility: Single source of truth for exercise-name canonicalization (canonicalize, _SYNONYMS) and the app's 10-value MUSCLE_GROUPS vocabulary.

shared_modules.notes: All Hevy list endpoints cap pageSize at 10 (per OpenAPI spec); page_size is clamped via _clamp_page_size so an over-cap value never 400s and silently zeroes a fetch (was the measurements_written:0 root cause). Superset grouping is read from the exercise field superset_id (SINGULAR) — the key the LIVE API returns; the published OpenAPI spec's supersets_id (plural) is WRONG, so the mapper prefers superset_id and falls back to supersets_id, and tests membership with `is not None` (group ids start at 0). Each grouped exercise row carries superset_with (single partner canonical, backward-compat) and superset_group (sorted list of ALL other member canonicals, lossless for 3+ member groups). Do not change back to the plural spelling to match the spec.

shared_modules.responsibility: LLM lift-parser path (annotate_workout), _write_exercise_rows, coach debrief. Re-exports canonicalization from exercise_canonical.
Epley e1RM, PR/stall detection, recompute_prs_for_canonicals, recompute_weekly_volume over fitness-exercises.
Proposes next workout from history + program config.

tables.name: fitness-daily-scores
tables.purpose: Daily composite scores + weekly volume roll-ups (week_<date>).

tables.name: fitness-workouts
tables.purpose: Rolled-up sessions (Strava cardio + Hevy strength keyed hevy_<id>).

tables.name: fitness-exercises
tables.purpose: Per-exercise-per-day rows; lift-learning engine substrate. Written by LLM parser and Hevy poller (source field).

hevy_ingestion.trigger: IngestFunction hevy_poll daily schedule (or action=hevy_poll); explicit action=hevy_backfill (or hevy_poll with force_full/reset_watermark) for a full re-sync
hevy_ingestion.auth: api-key header; secret hevy-api-key (Secrets Manager us-west-2, JSON {api_key})

modes.incremental: GET /v1/workouts/events?since=<hevy_last_sync> when a watermark exists (updates + deletions).
modes.cold_start: bounded page-walk of GET /v1/workouts when no watermark.
modes.backfill: action=hevy_backfill (or force_full/reset_watermark): IGNORES the watermark, full page-walk (default pageSize 10 x max_pages 20 = up to 200 workouts, both event-overridable), forces both writes regardless of dupe state and forces a template refresh, then advances the watermark. Idempotent, safely re-runnable.

steps: Refresh exercise-template cache (fitness-user-config key=hevy_exercise_templates) if older than ~7 days (forced on backfill). pageSize clamped to Hevy's max of 10.
Fetch workouts per mode (incremental / cold_start / backfill above).

Per workout (_apply_hevy_workout), DECOUPLED writes: the rolled-up fitness-workouts row (workout_to_row) and the per-exercise fitness-exercises rows (workout_to_exercise_rows, source=hevy) are independent. The session-row dupe-check (_hevy_row_is_duplicate) only suppresses the redundant fitness-workouts put; it NEVER gates the exercise-row write. A workout whose session row is unchanged but whose exercise rows are missing is BACKFILLED (existence checked via _hevy_exercise_rows_exist on (canonical,date)); a fully-synced workout is a cheap skip; backfill/force_full rewrites both unconditionally. All writes are idempotent overwrites.
Delete workouts removed in Hevy from fitness-workouts and their source=hevy fitness-exercises rows.
recompute_prs_for_canonicals + recompute_weekly_volume for touched canonicals (including backfilled ones); _trigger_compute for touched dates.

Ingest GET /v1/body_measurements (pageSize clamped to Hevy's max of 10 -- an over-cap value 400s and silently returns empty, the measurements_written:0 root cause) into fitness-health-metrics under #hevy sources (cm->in, kg->lb) via merge/ordering-guard helpers. Summary reports measurements_status ok/empty/error so a zero is never ambiguous.
hevy_ingestion.notes: Hevy public API exposes no calories/HR: strain estimated, cal flagged cal_unavailable. Never a bare put_item overwrite for metrics (PR #2 regression guard).
